lines.t: The Holy Seed fell deep into the earth
Planted three days and nights in the grave’s dark hold
The grain of wheat surrendered all in love
Yet burst forth in power, shattering death’s cold
No tomb could bind the Everlasting Life
The stone is rolled away — behold the risen King!
I AM THE VICTORY! The Firstfruits from death!
Risen and alive, breathing resurrection breath!
All who believe in Me shall not die but live
I shall raise them up at the Last Day — glory I give!
Firstfruits of the harvest, the wave that leads the rest
Death turned backward forever, only life shall be blessed!
The Firstborn from the dead, forever shall reign
Shout it loud, all creation — The Holy One has overcome!
Behold! I AM RISEN — Your Redeemer lives!
The old order is passing, new glory He gives
No more tears, no more pain, no more night shall remain
The promise is fulfilled, the victory is plain!
The power to lay down, the power to take up again!
The Holy One of Israel has overcome the end!
Those given to Me shall likewise come forth in might
When the shout rings out at the breaking of endless light!
The second death has no hold, the grave gives up its own
The dead in Me awaken — risen and crowned!
I AM THE VICTORY! The Firstfruits from death!
Risen and alive, breathing resurrection breath!
All who believe in Me shall not die but live
I shall raise them up at the Last Day — glory I give!
Firstfruits of the harvest, the wave that leads the rest
Death turned backward forever, only life shall be blessed!
The Firstborn from the dead, forever shall reign
Every knee bows, every tongue cries — YahuShua has overcome!
I AM THE VICTORY! The Firstfruits from death!
Risen and alive, breathing resurrection breath!
All who believe in Me shall not die but live
I shall raise them up at the Last Day — glory I give!
Firstfruits of the harvest, the wave that leads the rest
Death turned backward forever, only life shall be blessed!
The Firstborn from the dead, forever shall reign
Every knee bows, every tongue cries — YahuShua has overcome!
I AM RISEN!
The Holy Seed has sprung forth in power and might!
I AM RISEN!
The Firstfruits from death has conquered the night!
I AM RISEN!
Death is defeated, the victory is won!
I AM RISEN!
The harvest is coming — the many shall come!
I AM RISEN!
Forever and ever, the King is alive!
I AM THE VICTORY!
The Firstfruits… The Resurrection… The Life!
Evil blotted out — only righteousness remains!
Amen and amen — forever glorified!
